value.rationale: The necessary/sufficient all-population characterization of participation reversals exposes exactly when tied-bottom creation or resolution overturns a preferred winner. This diagnostic structural classification extends a published minimal witness into arbitrary-electorate criteria and a natural complete first-boundary orbit; it is not an arbitrary computation or small numerical improvement.
